{
  "name": "Back in Stock Notifier",
  "slug": "back-in-stock-notifier",
  "database": {
    "tables": [
      {
        "name": "waitlist_entries",
        "purpose": "Stores every shopper signup for a sold-out item, tracks queue position, notification status, and conversion.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                  "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "email",               "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "item_external_id",    "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the variant or product external id the shopper is waiting on; combined with item_scope to determine the level of the signup" },
          { "name": "item_scope",          "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "enum": ["variant", "product"], "purpose": "discriminates between a variant-level and a product-level signup" },
          { "name": "product_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "always the parent product external id; used to purge all entries on product deletion without a join" },
          { "name": "queue_position",      "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "monotonically increasing integer within each item, used to fan out notifications in sign-up order" },
          { "name": "status",              "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'", "enum": ["active", "notified", "converted", "unsubscribed", "purged"], "purpose": "lifecycle state" },
          { "name": "unsubscribe_token",   "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "opaque token embedded in every notification email for one-click global unsubscribe" },
          { "name": "restock_event_id",    "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "NULL", "purpose": "set when the entry is notified; references the restock_events row that triggered the notification, enforcing one notification per restock per entry" },
          { "name": "notified_at",         "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NULL" },
          { "name": "converted_at",        "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NULL" },
          { "name": "created_at",          "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["email", "item_external_id"],
        "indexes": [
          ["item_external_id", "status", "queue_position"],
          ["product_external_id"],
          ["email", "status"],
          ["unsubscribe_token"],
          ["restock_event_id"]
        ],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "restock_events",
        "purpose": "Records each distinct restock event for an item so the system knows which entries have already been notified for a given restock and prevents duplicate blasts.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                           "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()" },
          { "name": "item_external_id",             "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the variant or product external id that was restocked" },
          { "name": "item_scope",                   "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "enum": ["variant", "product"], "purpose": "discriminates variant-level vs product-level, mirrors waitlist_entries.item_scope" },
          { "name": "inventory_item_external_id",   "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the inventory item id from the webhook, used as the idempotency key to prevent duplicate restock events" },
          { "name": "available_quantity",           "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "units available at the moment the restock was detected" },
          { "name": "notification_budget",          "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "number of entries authorised to be notified; computed as min(available_quantity, active_waitlist_count)" },
          { "name": "notified_count",               "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 0", "purpose": "running count of entries actually notified in this event" },
          { "name": "status",                       "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'", "enum": ["open", "dispatching", "completed"], "purpose": "event lifecycle" },
          { "name": "detected_at",                  "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["inventory_item_external_id", "status"],
        "indexes": [
          ["item_external_id", "status"],
          ["inventory_item_external_id"]
        ],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "conversion_records",
        "purpose": "Records confirmed conversions where a notified shopper purchased the item within the 7-day attribution window.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()" },
          { "name": "waitlist_entry_id", "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES waitlist_entries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the waitlist entry credited with the conversion" },
          { "name": "order_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the paid order that triggered the conversion check; also the idempotency key" },
          { "name": "item_external_id",  "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the specific item that was purchased, for per-item conversion stats" },
          { "name": "converted_at",      "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["waitlist_entry_id", "order_external_id"],
        "indexes": [
          ["order_external_id"],
          ["item_external_id"]
        ],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "notification_settings",
        "purpose": "Merchant-configured notification template content and quiet-hours window; singleton row.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",               "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "singleton row guard; application code enforces at most one row" },
          { "name": "template_subject", "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "merchant-authored subject line supporting {{product_name}} and {{item_details}} tokens" },
          { "name": "template_body",    "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "merchant-authored message body supporting {{product_name}}, {{item_details}}, and {{unsubscribe_url}} tokens" },
          { "name": "quiet_hours_start","sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 22", "purpose": "hour-of-day (0-23) at which the quiet window begins" },
          { "name": "quiet_hours_end",  "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 8", "purpose": "hour-of-day (0-23) at which the quiet window ends" },
          { "name": "updated_at",       "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": [],
        "indexes": [],
        "foreignKeys": []
      }
    ]
  },
  "shopifyIntegration": {
    "webhookTopics": [
      "inventory_levels/update",
      "products/delete",
      "orders/paid"
    ],
    "cronSchedule": null
  },
  "httpRoutes": {
    "widget": [
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/widget/availability" },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/widget/signup" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/widget/signup" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/widget/unsubscribe" }
    ],
    "admin": [
      { "method": "GET", "path": "/admin/dashboard" },
      { "method": "GET", "path": "/admin/waitlist" },
      { "method": "GET", "path": "/admin/waitlist/export" },
      { "method": "GET", "path": "/admin/settings" },
      { "method": "PUT", "path": "/admin/settings" },
      { "method": "GET", "path": "/admin/stats" }
    ]
  }
}
